title: Scalable simulation of non-Markovian quantum transport by stochastic-phase bath reduction
summary: Accurate simulations of non-Markovian quantum transport remain limited to small systems, and a key bottleneck is that each system site requires an independent set of quantum bath orbitals. We introduce the Stochastic Phase Algorithm (SPA), which replaces the independent local Gaussian baths in single-quasiparticle Holstein models by $R$ shared quantum baths with stochastic site-dependent phases. We prove that phase averaging reproduces the target two-point bath correlation matrix for every $R$, while increasing $R$ systematically suppresses errors from higher-order cross-site correlations.…
